name: Astral-Cwm
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, a nearby asteroid belt. Nothing wears any of it smooth.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Whoever controls aluminum controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
